preregistration.note: Thresholds were registered before the input inventory returned and before any statistic was computed. This file restates them verbatim; any divergence is a defect in this file.

CORRECTED.description: incumbent basis as committed in R2/R3
CORRECTED.market_cap: split-adjusted close_t x (as-reported shares x cumulative split factor applied from the shares' report date forward)

DIRECT.market_cap: as-traded UNADJUSTED close_t x point-in-time as-reported shares_t
DIRECT.unadjusted_close_rule: unadj(sym,t) = closes[t] x product of split ratios dated strictly after t, using the per-symbol splits map in data/edgar/r1-panel/prices/{SYM}.json
DIRECT.shares_rule: raw as-reported EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding value, filed <= origin and end within the committed sharesAt window, never split-restated

unchanged_by_G0: cell selection rule including the shareBasisLo/Hi outlier filter

input_contract.prices: data/edgar/r1-panel/prices/{SYM}.json (503 symbols; closes are split-adjusted and dividend-unadjusted)

pre_stated_predictions.note: Stated before computation. A break is first a suspected implementation error and must be adjudicated as such before it is read as a gate signal.
pre_stated_predictions.P1: firm-level ICC is bit-identical across bases (ICC is computed from per-share quantities only)
pre_stated_predictions.P4: bi-dimensional B/P-tercile ICC spread unchanged (uses no market cap)
pre_stated_predictions.P5: market cap differs only where a split falls between the shares-report date and the origin date; ratio is exactly 1 elsewhere

C1_market_cap_rank_correlation.quantity: per-origin cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation of DIRECT vs CORRECTED market cap
C1_market_cap_rank_correlation.rationale: two measurements of one economic quantity; below this the ordering itself moves and every downstream cross-sectional statistic is basis-dependent by construction

C2_icc_difference.rationale: 25 bp against the committed 7.4% median ICC is a 3.4% relative shift; the tail bound stops a small median from hiding a broken subset. Expected value under P1 is exactly zero; a non-zero result is investigated as an implementation defect before it is scored.

C4_bidimensional_spread.quantity: ICC high-minus-low spread within B/P terciles

C5_per_origin_sign.quantity: sign of every per-origin ICC coefficient in the control set

verdict_mapping.G0_MATERIAL_BASIS_DEPENDENCE: any one fails; public numeric release of the ICC lens is refused regardless of later gates

data_contract_stop.condition: DIRECT computable for fewer than 95% of the firm-origin cells CORRECTED covers
data_contract_stop.action: not a pass and not a fail; report to owner, do not substitute inputs, do not relax the definition

prohibitions: no post-result change to any threshold, band, set, or basis rule
no feedback of a price-implied ICC into a same-date fair-value discount rate
no network acquisition to satisfy a coverage gap
